paite: Edom gam a kipan hong pai, Bozrah a kipan puansilh diahsan silh kua ahia? Apuansilh a thupitak, ahatna thupidan bang a hong pai? Kei TOUPA diktattak a thu gen a, hotdam lam a mihat mahmah ka hi.
heading: Namte Tung a TOUPA Vualzawlna
english: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

paite: Bangziak a na puansilh san a, na silh-le-tente leng grep sukna khuk a chiltaimi' silh-le-ten bang a om ahia?
english: Why are you red in your clothing, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

paite: Keimah kia in grep sukna khuk ah ka chiltai a; michih lak a mi khat lel leng ka kiang ah a-om kei uh; ahi, amau ka heh a ka chil a, ka heh a ka pal a; huchi in ahinna sisan uh ka puansilhte ah theh in a-om a, ka puan tengteng ka hihninta hi.
english: “I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the peoples there was no man with me: yes, I trod them in my anger, and trampled them in my wrath; and their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.

paite: Phulak ni ka lungtang ah a-om a, ka tatkhiakna kum ahong tungta ahi.
english: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, panpih ding mi a-om kei ua; len ding mi a-om louh uh lamdang ka sa a; huaiziak in keimah ban mahmah in hotdamna ahon puak a; ka hehna in ahon lenkip hi.
english: I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore my own arm brought salvation to me; and my wrath, it upheld me.

paite: Huchi in michih ka heh in ka sikden a, ka heh in ka khamsak a, ahinna sisan uh lei ah ka bota hi.
english: I trod down the peoples in my anger, and made them drunk in my wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth.”

paite: TOUPA'N thil bangkim ahon vuh bang zel in TOUPA chitdan thute leh TOUPA phatna thute ka gen ding a; ahehpihnate leh azahngaihna thupidante bang zel a Israel inkuanpihte lak a ahoihna thupi mahmah a atung ua avuh thu leng ka gen ding hi.
heading: Israel Tung A TOUPA Hoihna
english: I will make mention of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka mite, hi taktak hi ua, zuautat lou ding tate ahi uh," achi hi. Huchi in amaute hondampa ding in ahong omta hi.
english: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely:” so he was their Savior.

paite: Amangbatna tengteng uah amah amangbang a, angel, ama a om in, amaute ahumbit a; a-itna leh ahehpihna in atanta a; nidanglai ni tengteng ah amaute pua in apom hi.
english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

paite: Himahleh ahel un, a Kha Siangthou alungkhamsak ua; huaiziak in amau dou ding in kilehheisak in a-om a, amau asualta hi.
english: But they rebelled, and grieved his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

paite: Huai lai in amite'n Mosi nidanglai nite atheigige ua, hichi in achi uh, "Tuipi a kipan a abelamching mite toh amaute pi TOUPA koi a om ahia? A Kha Siangthou alak ua koihpa koi a om ahia?
english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? where is he who put his holy Spirit in their midst?

paite: Aban thupitak Mosi taklam a paisakpa koi a om ahia? Tangtawn min kibawlna dia ama ua tui kikhensakpa koi a om ahia?
english: who caused his glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses? who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

paite: Akisuihlouhna ding ua tui thuktak a, gamdai a sakol pi bang a, amaute pikaipa koi a om ahia?
english: who led them through the depths, as a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?

paite: Guam a ganta paisukte bang in TOUPA Kha in amaute akhawlsak a; huchibang in, min thupitak na kibawlna ding in, na mite na pi hi," chi in.
english: As the livestock that go down into the valley, the Spirit of Yahweh caused them to rest; so you led your people, to make yourself a glorious name.

paite: TOUPA, Van a kipan in hon ensuk inla, na sianthouna leh na thupina omna a kipan in hon en in; na phatuamngaihna leh na thilhih thupitakte koi ah? Na lungtang a na hon ngaihna leh na hon hehpihna, kham a omta hia?
heading: Panpihna Leh Lainatna Ngen A Thumna
english: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory: where are your zeal and your mighty acts? the yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.

paite: Abraham in hon thei lou in, Israel in leng hon limsak kei mahleh, nang zaw ka Pa uh na hi a; nang zaw, aw TOUPA, ka Pa uh na hi; na min tangtawn a kipan in koute hon Tanpa ahi.
english: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us: you, Yahweh, are our Father; our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang bangziak a na lampi a kipan hon vakmangsak na hia? Na sikha, na gouluah namte ziak in hong kik nawn in.
english: O Yahweh, why do you make us to err from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

paite: Na misiangthoute'n sawt louchik kia anei ua; hon doute'n lah na min siangthou asikgawpta uh.
english: Your holy people possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

paite: Atung ua vai na hawm ngeilouhte, na min pu ngeilou namte ka bangta uhi.
english: We have become as they over whom you never bear rule, as those who were not called by your name.
